draftedFindings.title: first panics when n exceeds the slice length
draftedFindings.body: `&items[..n]` panics if callers request more elements than are present, e.g. `first(&[1, 2], 3)`. The existing `last` helper handles this case by returning the whole slice, so `first` should likely mirror that behavior with `&items[..items.len().min(n)]`.
